recognize_zh: HPLC 圖中 HbA（Ao 62.6%）仍是主峰，但 3.60 分鐘 A2 視窗出現約 27.5% 的高峰，HbF 0.6%；A2 視窗內 25–30% 的變異量遠超過 β 地中海貧血帶因的 4–8%，符合 HbE 帶因（HbE trait）。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram
Large A2-window peak at 3.60 min quantified at 27.5%
HbF 0.6%; small P2, P3 and unknown minor peaks
No D- or S-window variant peak
describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows a major HbA peak (62.6%) and a large peak eluting at 3.60 minutes in the HbA2 window, quantified at 27.5% on this printout (the figure legend cites 23.8%). HbF is 0.6% and no D- or S-window variants are present. An A2-window fraction in the 20-30% range with preserved HbA reflects a co-eluting variant, most commonly HbE, rather than true HbA2. Findings are consistent with HbE trait in the mother of the index case; alkaline electrophoresis or DNA analysis can confirm HbE.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait raises true HbA2 only to about 4-8%, far below the 20-30% A2-window peak of HbE trait.
Hb Lepore elutes in or near the A2 window but at only about 5-15% with mildly raised HbF.

ddx.dx: HbE trait with coexisting alpha-thalassemia or iron deficiency
ddx.vs: Coinherited alpha-thalassemia or iron deficiency lowers the HbE fraction toward 20% or less, so a lower-than-expected HbE level warrants iron studies and alpha-globin testing.
